[[Northdale]] is a town in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], north of [[Light's Hope Chapel]] and southeast of the entrance to [[Quel'thalas]]. It is where [[Taelan Fordring]] renounced the [[Order of the Silver Hand]] and joined the [[Scarlet Crusade]]. The ruins of the town is inhabited by banshees and invisible eyeless watchers, and the nearby lake is populated by corrupted [[water elemental]]s.
